story: Apple launches $49.99 Intelligence Usage Packs, its first paid Apple Intelligence tier

segments.label: THIS WEEK IN AI
segments.title: Apple is now charging for AI
segments.narration: Apple is now charging for AI. Intelligence Usage Packs cost forty-nine dollars and ninety-nine cents.

segments.label: WHAT HAPPENED
segments.title: Apple sells AI usage packs
segments.narration: Apple is selling usage packs for more AI in its Creator Studio apps. Until now, Apple Intelligence was free.

segments.label: THE KEY DETAIL
segments.title: Creator Studio only, for now
segments.narration: For now, packs cover only Creator Studio apps. Apple says Apple Intelligence will not stay free forever.

segments.label: WHAT IT MEANS FOR YOU
segments.title: AI may become a budget line
segments.point: The catch: costs may creep up
segments.narration: If you use Creator Studio, budget for AI. The catch: costs may creep up.

segments.label: OUR TAKE
segments.title: Track usage before you buy
segments.point: Buy only if it saves time
segments.narration: Our take: track your usage first. Buy a pack only if it saves real time.
